component.name: PokeeFUC
component.summary: Native port of Monster Hunter Portable 2nd G with FUComplete

description.p: PokeeFUC runs Monster Hunter Portable 2nd G with the FUComplete patch natively, by static recompilation: the game's PSP code is translated ahead of time into native code and runs on a reimplementation of the PSP system software, with Vulkan graphics, gamepad support and PSP-compatible saves.

PokeeFUC does not include any game assets or original game files: no disc image, no copy of the game's executable or data, and no textures, models, audio or video from the game. You must provide the files from your own legally obtained copy of Monster Hunter Portable 2nd G patched with FUComplete: the first start checks that copy and sets the game up from it.
PokeeFUC is built from Pokee by its contributors. FUComplete is a separate project. Neither is affiliated with or endorsed by CAPCOM or Sony.
